purpose: Reference geometry and bounded collision exploration, never mechanical realization or physical qualification

coordinates.Y: plug insertion into host, mouth at Y=0
coordinates.rotation_order: roll about Y, then pitch about X, then yaw about Z, then translate

contact_model: Conservatively call insertion d>=0 potentially electrically connected, including shell; no real B01 contact timing inferred. Rotated poses can also graze the mouth before d=0; these are separately tested as approach/contact-box cases, not excluded merely by d<0.

prescribed_kinematics.rule: Each PRESENT key prescribes one shutter displacement: clip((d+lead-trigger)/2,0,1)*12. This is an imposed motion law, NOT a constructed cam/linkage or proof the key operates it. Missing keys do not move their shutter. Fault sweeps override shutters independently.
prescribed_kinematics.bridge_rule: Bridge lift is shown at12mm in PROGRAM as a reference pose. Real connector overlap, retention, force and interlock linkage remain unmodelled.
prescribed_kinematics.reconnect_probe_rule: Test each full-aperture probe at dock and its closure sweep for collision. Any detected positive-volume collision prevents the model from declaring empty. No force, deformation, spring, latch or frame-strength claim.

collision_methods.sweep: 15-axis OBB SAT, finite sampled poses; no continuous-coverage claim
collision_methods.kernel_crosscheck: Selected independently built build123d/OCCT solid intersections
collision_methods.tangency: reported separately; positive overlap beyond tolerance counts as collision

baseline: Outer-envelope-only solid reference, not guaranteed metal: rectangular bounds include voids/chamfers and maximum cross-section. Missing tail/overmould is unknown. A detection hit is NOT material-presence proof; a miss demonstrates inadequacy of this envelope, not an observed real cable bypass.
adversarial_addendum: Host-space key/trigger diagnostics include one-key roll0/180 and pitch/yaw5 degrees. Existing scalar motion remains explicitly imposed, not contact-driven. Collar and rear crossbar faults are separated. A rounded hollow shell with0.15mm assumed wall and smaller8.22x2.37x6.51 envelope is tested only for sensitivity, never a guaranteed material model.
negative_controls: Both shutters stuck open permits a generic nose to reach potential contact under the imposed-motion model
Truncated/missing collar can defeat the probe at deep insertion
One missing key with its own shutter also stuck open is a combined fault and can bypass imposed key logic
unmodelled: mechanical key-to-shutter linkage and independent pawl sequencing
damaged/noncompliant cables and thin foreign objects
common-frame break, terminal trailing and electrical contacts
exact B01, antenna and complete kit fit
continuous unsampled rotations/translations and manufacturing tolerances
provenance: USB and approved reference inputs inherited unchanged from the approved proposal; profile sizes, offset/angle grids and imposed motion are exploratory study outputs, not adopted product/configuration choices. No new manufacturing material or MPN.
